items.title: ECB Saw Need for Another Rate Hike Unless Inflation Outlook Improved ‘Significantly’
items.why: ECB policymakers said another rate hike may be needed unless the inflation outlook improves significantly.
items.summary_ai: ECB policymakers said another rate hike may be needed unless the inflation outlook improves significantly.

items.title: ECB expands acceptance of DLT-based assets as eligible Eurosystem collateral
items.why: The ECB will accept marketable assets issued on licensed DLT platforms as eligible Eurosystem collateral.
items.summary_ai: The ECB will accept marketable assets issued on licensed DLT platforms as eligible Eurosystem collateral.
